false_instrument_checks: Next.js registered build/route endpoint and Recovery execution
root_causes: protected-path manifest counted pytest-generated __pycache__ while the input manifest excluded runtime caches
default shutil.copytree dereferenced node_modules/.bin/next and changed the relative module-resolution base

analysis.a26_reuse_policy: no A26 arm, endpoint, report result, or descriptive contrast is reused in A27
analysis.descriptive_contrast_policy: record each paired binary endpoint contrast solely to validate the instrument; do not aggregate or report it as an effect estimate
analysis.go_next_action: request repository-owner review before preregistering or collecting a separate confirmatory conditional-effect experiment
analysis.go_rule: GO requires exactly one valid pair in generic, data, and Next.js; identical input and initial failure boundary within every pair; failed control endpoint; passed and promoted treatment endpoint; unchanged protected paths; pinned binary and provisioning
analysis.invalid_policy: freeze all A27 evidence, diagnose forward-only, and never replace, rerun, rescore, resize, or pool an A27 arm
analysis.no_go_next_action: perform forward-only instrument diagnosis without effect estimation

design.allocation: deterministic control then treatment order on independent fresh copies; no arm replacement or rerun
design.control_endpoint: the registered reproducer remains at exit 1, all registered regressions remain at exit 0, and the repair target is unchanged
design.endpoint: all scenario-registered verify commands pass; Next.js additionally requires the frozen / route selector to render ready-02
design.treatment_endpoint: one Recovery run mutates only the intended target/probe outputs, passes all registered commands, passes the Next.js route endpoint, and is promoted

estimand.contrast: Recovery auto-runs 1 versus 0 on the registered endpoint
estimand.name: conditional scripted fault-boundary Recovery availability
estimand.population: the three frozen A27 fixtures, scope-identical to A26, at the scripted, reproducible failure boundary only

forward_corrections.nextjs_provisioning_symlink_policy: copy every hash-bound node_modules entry with symlinks=True and preserve the relative .bin/next link target
forward_corrections.scope_change: none; retain the A26 scenarios, arms, endpoints, and order

historical_evidence_policy.A23: immutable INVALID natural-exposure pilot; never rescore or pool
historical_evidence_policy.A24: immutable INVALID natural-exposure pilot; never rescore or pool
historical_evidence_policy.A25: immutable GO instrument / NOT_MET natural-exposure pilot; never rescore or pool
historical_evidence_policy.A26: immutable INVALID deterministic paired pilot; never rerun, rescore, replace, or pool any arm

nextjs_provisioning.copy_policy: fresh private symlink-preserving copy before each A27 arm

report_exit_semantics: zero iff all preregistered paired instrument checks pass; nonzero freezes A27 as INVALID and requires forward-only diagnosis
